eet Jacksmith, a very talented Blacksmith,
and his furry apprentice, Scout.

Jacksmith enjoyed his job, but horseshoes and hinges
weren't paying the bills.

.
Across the Lowlands lived the Royal Plumpfeather family.

King Plumpfeather and his wife Hildread
have ruled over the land for many years.
Beyond Alpine Ridge lived a lonely wizard named Dudley.
He was obsessed with the King's beautiful daughter Liliana.

Using his powerful Phoenix Staff and a barrage of
Elemental Spells, Dudley kidnapped Liliana and
amassed an army of vile creatures.

The King set a reward for any brave soul
who could save his daughter.

Jacksmith, who desperately needed the money, packed up
the Forge and hit the road to save Princess Liliana.

Jacksmith could craft a flawless weapon,
but using one is not his specialty.
He's going to need some help...

Jacksmith, you have
proven yourself to be
a very talented and
brave Donkey.

My family is sincerely
thankful for your hand
in bringing Princess
Liliana back to
Plumpfeather Castle.

Along with your cash reward,
we also bestow onto you a
most prized possession...

...a single kiss
from the beautiful
Princess Liliana.

Your mission is complete,
but your journey has just begun.
More adventure and fortune await
as you travel down the road.

Any progress you've made since the start
of this crafting day will be lost!

You've called the local soldiers
to your cause!
Click to take a weapon order.
You'll need to craft him a sword.
You have four Crafting Stations in your workshop.
First choose this station to use.

You can only crafts swords right now.

Click the icon to start building!
Click this mold to create a longsword.
You'll earn molds for other swords as you travel.

You first need to choose a metal.

You'll earn metal ores to use later,
but right now you have an unlimited
supply of copper to use.

Wait for the copper to melt!

You can also pump the bellows to make
the metal melt faster.
The metal is ready! Slowly pull the chain downwards to pour into the sword mold.

If you pull too fast, the metal will spill
and your sword won't form correctly!
You need to hammer a sword to sharpen its edges. Click along the edges of the sword to hammer.
You can only swing the hammer 18 times, so try to space your hammering to make it all the way around the sword blade!
You build the handle of a sword by dropping parts onto it. First drag and release a Guard onto the sword's end.
Next drop a Grip onto the sword. Try to line up the parts correctly to make the sword more durable.
Next drop a Cap onto the sword to finish the hilt.
Click Finish to deliver this sword to a waiting swordsman!

You can see how well you crafted
the sword here.

You'll wait for three soldiers today.
Take this soldier's order, and start
building another sword!
Power = How much damage it deals

Better metals will create weapons
with more power and durability.

before breaking
If you hammer poorly, the swordwon't have as much Power in battle.

Hammer evenly around the edges to get
the maximum power for the sword.
If you build the handle crooked,your sword won't have as muchDurability in battle.

Craft one more sword,
then it's time to go to battle!
If you complete the day's weapons quickly,any time remaining on your Bonus Meterwill reward you with Gems!
The soldiers are going to battle using your weapons!

How well you built the weapons determines how well
they'll perform in battle!
Monsters will drop Loot when attacked.

Move your Mouse over the dropped items
to collect them!
You'll earn Experience Points (XP) whena monster is defeated, and they spray extraloot further down the trail!
Each weapon's Durability decreases whenit's used, and when a monster attacks.
When its durability reaches zero, the weaponwill break and that soldier will retreat!
If you defeat all of the monsters on a day's trail,you can collect an Epic Weapon Design and its parts from a treasure chest!
You've collected enough ore to craft aBronze Weapon!

It's even stronger than Copper, but you
have a limited supply of Bronze Ore.

You can use the loot you've collected
for new weapons!

You have a limited supply, but they give
extra stat boosts to your weapons.
Swordsmen can use any type of sword, so choose whicheverone has the best Elemental Boosts for today's enemies.
Each weapon type has its own elemental boost.Longswords deal extra Fire Damage to Fire Enemies,which will help with today's monsters!
You'll start seeing Fire Enemies todayin Cinder Springs!

These are stronger elemental enemies, but some
weapons and parts will help with different elements...
You'll now see Water Enemies as well asFire Enemies.

Visit the Shop to stock up on parts that have
Water Elemental Boosts to help fight these enemies!

You can now help your troops by
firing cannonballs!

Click the Button to fire a cannonball
at a monster.

You need to wait for your cannonball
to recharge before you can fire again.
You now have two types of cannonballs!
Click here to shoot a Fire Bomb ata monster, which deals extra damage over time.
Click here to drop a Repair Pack onyour troops, which restores some durabilityto all weapons!
Click here to drop a Lightning Bomb on enemies, which lowers their attack strength!
Click here to drop a Booster Bomb, which boosts all of your weapons' attack powerfor a limited time!
Click here to drop an Ice Bomb, which freezes an enemy and prevents themfrom attacking for a limited time!

You won't always defeat all of the
monsters on a trail.

Keep building better weapons
to keep making progress!
You can Scrap a weapon at any time during crafting,which will destroy that weapon and restore allmetal and parts to your inventory.

Drag both arms of the bow upwards to stretch the string.
Try to make it straight to earn the maximum Power for a Bow.
You need to Stretch this Bow.
Drag one of your Grips onto the middle of the Bow.
First drag an Arrowhead onto the arrow shaft.

Line it up with arrow shaft
to get maximum Durability!
Build the Axe Head by attaching all three parts to the center. Drag each blade and spike, and release when it's against the center. Keep them straight to get maximum Power for an Axe.
You need to Build the Handle for the Axe. First drag a Pole and drop it onto the axe. Keep it centered for maximum Durability, otherwise it will land crooked!
Drag a Grip and Cap onto the axe to finish the handle.
Choose a Paint to use on the shield.
Click and drag along the shield to paint the surface. Cover the whole surface for maximum Power, and keep painting until the Paint Meter is empty!
Place a Crest on a shield to finish it. Keep the crest centered for maximum Durability.
Drag all of the Pegs onto the Mace head to attach them.

Try to arrange them like the picture
on the right for maximum Power!
You can build an Epic Weapon using the Design you found earlier! Click the Designs book to open it.
All of the Epic Weapon Designs you find are shown here! Click the Bows icon to see your design.

see the recipe for this weapon.

to build this weapon, and a
if you have the parts already.

You can Bookmark the parts to keep track of what you're saving or building.
Parts that are Bookmarked will show this icon:

When you craft great weapons and earn points on a weapon's
Star Meter, you can unlock extra Elemental Boosts
for each weapon type!
Want to multitask?Click the Back button to take otherweapon orders and switch to other stations!

Don't worry if you don't reach the
Treasure Chest each day!

The Design and parts will be available in
other Treasure Chests during future battles.

As you travel down the road, many different enemies
will be blocking your path!

Your sidekick Scout will run ahead, and let you know
what kind of enemies you will have to face that day.
Sometimes you will encounter Elemental Enemies that are weak against a certain Elemental Boost. Build weapons that deal extra elemental damage for these enemies!
Soldiers in the area will help you, but they need weapons first!

Each soldier is skilled with a certain type of weapon.
Swordsmen can only use swords,
and archers can only use bows.

Soldiers will wait until you craft a weapon, and will then join
you in battle at the end of the day.

Your wagon has four Crafting Stations where you can
build a weapon. You can use any station -- and can use all
of them at once when multitasking!
You will unlock three different molds for each type of weapon.Soldiers can use any of the three variations, but eachof them has a different Elemental Boost!

If you craft a great weapon, that mold's Star Meter
will begin to fill up. When the meter is filled, you will unlock
extra Elemental Boosts for that weapon variation!

Each type of weapon has a different process for crafting.
All weapons need to be forged using your collected metals,
and some weapons share similar parts (like Grips).
Each weapon has two main stats:

The Power and Durability for a weapon come from the metal
you use to create it. Better metals have higher stats.

Parts that you collect or buy will also have additional
Stat Boosts, to make your weapon even stronger.

If you craft a weapon poorly, the stats will go down, and it
won't do as well in battle. Craft a great weapon to get the
maximum Power and Durability!
How long the weapon lasts before breaking

If your overall Luck for your group of soldiers is high enough,
enemies may drop more items and better metals!
Some parts will have a Luck Stat:
Weapons and parts can also have Elemental Boostsin addition to their regular stats. Check the "Element Chart"section for more information.

Use the Gems you collect ( ) to buy
weapon parts from Gander’s shop.

New items are added each day, and old items are removed,
so keep checking back to find that part you want!
You can also buy some extra metal ore when it's in stock.

Gander is a traveling salesman, so he can only carry
one of each part in stock each day.

The soldiers go to battle using your weapons!
How well you built the weapons determines how well
they’ll perform in battle.

Monsters will drop loot when attacked.
Move your mouse over the dropped items to collect them!

Each weapon’s Durability goes down when it’s used,
and also goes down when an enemy attacks.
When Durability reaches zero, the weapon will break
and that soldier will retreat.

You’ll earn Experience Points (XP) when a monster is defeated,
and they spray extra loot down the trail.

View the separate topics in the "Battle" section to learn
more details about the battle.

When your metal is melted, SLOWLY pull the chain downwards
to pour it into the mold. If you pull too fast, the metal will
spill and your sword won't form correctly!

Don't leave your metal melting for too long! If it's overdone,
the metal will form cracks when it cools, and not be
as durable in battle.

You need to hammer a sword to sharpen its edges.
Click along the edges of the sword to hammer.

You can only swing the hammer a certain number of times,
so try to space out your hammering to make it all the way
around the blade!

The Falchion only needs to be sharpened on one side,
but you can't swing the hammer as many times.

If you hammer poorly, the sword won't have as much
Power in battle. Hammer evenly around the edges to get
the maximum Power for your sword.

You build the handle of a sword by dropping parts onto it.
First drag and release a GUARD onto the sword's end,
then a GRIP, then a CAP.

If you build the handle crooked, your sword won't have
as much Durability in battle and will break quickly.
Line up the parts correctly to get the maximum Durability.

You need to stretch a bow before a soldier can use it.
Drag both "arms" of the bow upwards to stretch the string.
Try to make it straight to earn the maximum Power for the bow.

Drag one of your Grips onto the middle of the Bow.
Many weapons use the same parts, like Grips.

Drag an Arrowhead onto the arrow shaft.
Line it up with the arrow shaft to keep it straight
and get maximum Durability!
Drag a Fletching onto the other end of the arrow shaft.

You need to build the Axe head by attaching all three parts
to the center.

Drag each blade and spike, and release when it's against
the center piece. Keep them straight to get maximum
Power for the axe.

Be sure to put each blade on the correct side! If you have it
on the wrong side, it will look crooked and won't line up
correctly.

You need to build the handle of the Axe using a Pole, Grip,
and Cap.

Keep each part centered when you drop it for maximum
Durability. If it's not centered, it will land crooked, and
won't be as durable!

You first need to choose a paint to use on a Shield.
Some paints will have extra Stat Boosts.

Click and drag across the surface of the Shield to apply
the paint. Cover the whole surface of the Shield for
maximum Power!

Keep dragging and painting until the "Paint Meter" above
the Shield is completely empty. Don't leave any blank spots!

Place a Crest on a shield to finish it. Keep the Crest centered
for maximum Durability.

You need to hammer a Pike blade just like a Sword blade.
Pike blades are shaped differently, so make sure you hammer
on the edges that look like they should be sharp!

You build a Pike handle just like an Axe handle, but it's
much longer! You'll need to use more Poles and Grips
to build one.

Drag all of the Pegs or Spikes onto the
Mace head to attach them.

There is a picture showing how each Mace type should
have its spikes arranged. Try to make it look like
that picture!
Arrange the spikes correctly for maximum Power!

Be careful with the Battle Mace -- its spikes need to be
attached differently than the other two!

Many parts will give Elemental Boosts to your weapons.

If you attach a part poorly, you may not get the full
Elemental Boost amount, so be careful!

Used in an Epic Weapon Design
that you've collected in Battle
Each weapon variation comes with different Elemental Boosts.

If you make a great weapon, that variation's Star Meter
will start to fill up. When the meter is completely full,
you will unlock EXTRA Elemental Boosts for that
weapon variation!

Each variation starts with one Boost,
and has three extra Boosts to unlock
(Bronze, Silver, and Gold)

Longswords deal extra damage to Fire Enemies,
and the Gladius deals extra damage to Water Enemies.

These Elemental Boosts are added on top of the usual
weapon Power and Durability.

B: Enemies on this trail
C: Current enemy (highlighted)

(will flash when you deal Elemental Damage)

In the Lowlands, you'll only see basic enemies.
Once you reach Cinder Springs and beyond, you'll start
seeing stronger Elemental Enemies as well!
Elemental Enemies are each weak against a certain Elemental Boost. Build weapons that deal extra elemental damage for these enemies!
As you travel further, monsters will get larger and stronger!

Check the "Beasts" Book to see all of the types of
monsters you've already encountered.

Enemies will drop loot every time a soldier attacks!
Move your mouse over dropped loot to collect it.

When you defeat an enemy, they'll spray extra loot down
the trail. This loot usually contains better metals and
weapon parts.

If you craft stronger weapons, enemies may drop
better metal ores as loot! When you start crafting Bronze
weapons, enemies will start dropping some Iron Ore.

Use weapon parts with a Luck Boost ( ), and
enemies will have a chance to drop more loot and
better metal ores!

If you defeat all of the enemies on a trail, you'll reach
a Treasure Chest that has special loot: An Epic Weapon Design
and the parts required to build it!

You won't always reach the Treasure Chest if your
weapons break, so you won't always get a new Epic Weapon.

Be sure to collect all of the parts that pour out of the
Treasure Chest, including the Design Scroll!

Don't worry if you don't reach the Treasure Chest each day!
The Design and parts in that Treasure Chest will be
available in other Treasure Chests during future battles.

You will eventually unlock a Cannon for your wagon,
so you can help your troops in battle!

Click on one of the Cannonball buttons to launch
a cannonball into the field.

After you use your cannon, it will need to recharge
before you can fire that type of cannonball again.

You will unlock some cannonballs that fire at
your troops instead of the enemy!

The Repair Bomb will repair some of
the durability on all of your weapons.

The Booster Bomb will give all of your soldiers a
boosted attack power for a limited time!

Some cannonballs will affect the enemies
temporarily!

The Fire Bomb will slowly deal damage to the enemy
as the fire burns.

The Lightning Bomb will zap an enemy's attack
power for a limited time, so you take less damage
from their attacks.

The Ice Bomb will freeze an enemy in place for a limited
time, so they can't fight back!

If you defeat all of the monsters on a trail, you'll reach a
Treasure Chest that contains an Epic Weapon Design and the
parts needed to build it. Be sure to collect everything
that drops out of the chest!

Click the "Designs" book to browse through any
Weapon Designs you've collected.
You can also press D on the keyboard, or go to the
Designs page from the MENU button.

A: Tabs for different weapon types
B: List of designs found for this weapon type
C: Parts needed to build this weapon
D: Bonus Effect given to soldiers when you build this
E: Bookmark Button
Design names will be shown in GREEN in the list if youcurrently have all of the parts and metals needed to build it.

Design names will have a Star if you've built at least one
of this Epic Weapon before.

Each Epic Weapon design gives a Bonus Effect to ALL
of the soldiers on that day if you build one.

This Bonus Effect is added to each weapon's stats during
the battle.

Need to face some Fire Enemies?
Try building an Epic Weapon that gives a bonus
Fire Boost to all of your soldiers.

Even if this weapon uses a low-quality metal, it may be even
more helpful to build it and gain the Fire Boost for everyone!

You won't always have the parts needed to make one
of your Epic Weapons.

You can "Bookmark" a design's parts so you don't
accidentally use them on a different weapon.

Bookmarked parts will show a striped background and
Bookmark icon when you're building and browsing
your inventory:

You can have multiple designs bookmarked at once,
and you can remove a bookmark whenever you like.

Bookmark ribbons will be colored to match the type
of weapon that the part is needed for.

Molds will also show a Bookmark icon if they're bookmarked,
and Metal Ores will show an icon and the amount needed.

Any parts that are used in an Epic Weapon Design
you have collected, even if it isn't currently
bookmarked, will also show this icon:

After you craft an Epic Weapon, it will automatically
remove that bookmark (if it was bookmarked).

If a part is used in Epic Weapon Designs you have
collected, but you've already made those designs at
least once, it will instead show this icon:

Use those small scroll symbols to decide if you want to save
a part to use in a Design later, or if something is safe
to use in your current weapon.

After you start a game, your progress is automatically
saved after completing each battle!
Your game progress is saved directly to your computer.

If you are having trouble saving your progress, make sure
you have plenty of storage space available so there is room
for your game progress to be saved.

You can change how the game is displayed on your computer
within the App Settings screen.
Press the button while playing to open App Settings.

You can also press the Escape key on your keyboard to open
the App Settings screen at any time, and you can also find
the button on the title screen.

You can change whether you want the game to appear
Full Screen, and can change the window size between
various widescreen and classic (square) sizes.

If your computer is having issues where the game is
running slowly, you can change the Graphics Quality to
lower settings to improve performance.

You can also display the game in smaller window sizes
if you are having performance issues with how the game
is running on your computer.

There are options to mute the music, mute sound effects,
change master volume, and quit the app from this menu.

You can adjust some gameplay settings
from the SETTINGS menu.

If you disable "Screen Shake", the screen will no longer
shake when hammering weapons or during battle.

When forging metals, the Pull Chain is tailored for easy
mouse controls, especially when playing at full screen.

If you'd like to make the chain follow your mouse exactly,
or if you're using a touch screen, you can disable
the "Easy-to-Drag Forge Chain" option.

You can use Keyboard Shortcuts to switch between screens
while crafting weapons.

You can also use Keyboard Shortcuts during battle to fire
your cannon.
